goal: Create a new class to encapsulate all long-based bitfield logic so the original BitField class is smaller and focuses on int/short/byte variants.

ops.details: Create a new class org.apache.commons.lang3.BitFieldLong containing its own private final long mask and private final int shiftCount fields, the constructor BitFieldLong(long mask), and all long-specific operations copied from BitField: clear(long), getRawValue(long), getValue(long), isAllSet(long), isSet(long), set(long), setBoolean(long, boolean), and setValue(long, long). The new class is standalone in the same package and uses only standard Java APIs so it compiles independently.
